title: Practice: некого, нечего — and никого, ничего

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books; word forms checked with the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Это была небольшая и ___ не примечательная булочная.
exercises.why: **ничем** — with the negative verb: «Used with any negative (НЕ) form of the verb, both in personal and impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 104.
exercises.prompt: It was a small and unremarkable bakery.

exercises.q: Скажи ей, что нет ___ зазорного в том, чтобы плакать.
exercises.why: **ничего** — with the negative verb: «Used with any negative (НЕ) form of the verb, both in personal and impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 104.
exercises.prompt: Tell her there's no shame in crying.

exercises.why: **ничего** — with the negative verb: «Used with any negative (НЕ) form of the verb, both in personal and impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 104.
exercises.prompt: An eight-year-old car is almost worthless.

exercises.q: ___ нет дела, что ты провернул в воздухе бутылку с водой.
exercises.why: **Никому** — with the negative verb: «Used with any negative (НЕ) form of the verb, both in personal and impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 104.
exercises.prompt: No one cares that you did a water bottle flip.

exercises.q: Девочка никогда не улыбается ___, кроме Эмилии.
exercises.why: **никому** — with the negative verb: «Used with any negative (НЕ) form of the verb, both in personal and impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 104.
exercises.prompt: The little girl never smiles at anyone other than Emily.

exercises.q: В отличие от тебя, я ___ не высмеиваю публично.
exercises.why: **никого** — with the negative verb: «Used with any negative (НЕ) form of the verb, both in personal and impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 104.
exercises.prompt: Unlike you, I don't make fun of people in public.

exercises.why: **нечего** — followed by an infinitive, no НЕ: «Used with the infinitive of the verb (without НЕ) in impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 104.
exercises.prompt: The proletarians have nothing to lose but their chains.

exercises.why: **Нечего** — followed by an infinitive, no НЕ: «Used with the infinitive of the verb (without НЕ) in impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 104.
exercises.prompt: Don't make such a parade of your wealth.

exercises.why: **некого** — followed by an infinitive, no НЕ: «Used with the infinitive of the verb (without НЕ) in impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 104.
exercises.prompt: I've got no one else to ask.

exercises.why: **нечем** — followed by an infinitive, no НЕ: «Used with the infinitive of the verb (without НЕ) in impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 104.
exercises.prompt: I have nothing to boast about.

exercises.why: **нечему** — followed by an infinitive, no НЕ: «Used with the infinitive of the verb (without НЕ) in impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 104.
**нечем** — followed by an infinitive, no НЕ: «Used with the infinitive of the verb (without НЕ) in impersonal constructions» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 104.
exercises.prompt: There's nothing to be proud of.
